title: Choose the look for Backdrop Studio
question: The roll assigned Swing Tag. Keep it, take an alternate, the category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Swing Tag
options.lineage: boutique hang tags: kraft card, punched eyelet, stamped price
options.thesis: Every product, set and template wears its own hang tag; the app is a rail of tagged stock.
options.viewport: Ink rail on the left; the review shows each colour as a tag hung from one rail, its shots as tear-off stubs, the GH₵ stamp and Generate pinned at the foot.
options.risk: Tag shapes on everything turns into costume; only item cards get the notch and eyelet, every control stays standard.

raised.raise: Fixed furniture: every tag shows name, swatches, shot count and one-line state in the same place.
Registration: every image of a set sits at one scale on one baseline, so colours compare directly.
One ramp carries hierarchy: a stub's fill shows progress before any word does.
Tones snap to one kraft-to-ink ramp; saturated colour is reserved for state.

options.label: Contact Sheet
options.lineage: photographers' proof sheets marked in grease pencil
options.thesis: A set is a proof sheet: each colour a film strip, each shot a frame, selects circled in grease pencil.
options.viewport: Black film-strip rows per colour with numbered frames per shot; the AI's sorting shows as red circles you can move.
options.risk: The most familiar photo-tool metaphor; most runs in this category land near here.

options.label: Retail Mosaic
options.thesis: Every colour, shot, cost and state tiled as ruled modules on one screen.
options.viewport: A packed mosaic: one module per colour × shot, red tabs for status, prices and counts in the gutters.
options.case: Holds product clarity (colours × shots at a glance); loses audience identification, and density hurts the phone review.
options.risk: Tiny type at phone width; reads busy when the grid is not strict.

options.label: Gate Board
options.lineage: boarding pass and live departures board
options.thesis: Generation as a departures board: images rerank by state and a finished one stays lit until seen.
options.viewport: Each set is a pass with a stub; its images run as board rows, the newly finished row held in amber.
options.case: Holds product clarity for the queue and results; loses audience identification, and upload/review don't map to travel.
options.risk: Travel costume if the board leaks beyond the results screen.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: A ranked roster of pastel cells, each with fixed personal furniture.
options.viewport: A pastel roster grid of products as characters.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a fashion seller doesn't see her stock as mascots.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Plates at one fixed scale and ground across stages.
options.viewport: Registered plates of each colour side by side.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cream-and-serif editorial, far from the shop's world.
options.kept: Registration at one scale and baseline.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Hierarchy carried by one magnitude ramp.
options.case: Fuses poorly on both axes: no tie to fashion retail or to the task.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Stacked translucent sheets on an eleven-step zone ramp.
options.viewport: Sheets slide aside to reveal each step.
options.case: Fuses poorly: abstract hatching hides a simple sort-and-generate task.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean commerce admin, like Shopify's own, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar nav, white cards, a tidy table of colours × shots with status badges.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other admin by design.
